phases.name: reliability
phases.notes: Shared queues, PDF freshness, active producers, bounded no-progress, retryable scoring, incremental document commits, scope/threshold consistency and structured results.

phases.name: configuration_and_sources
phases.notes: Lossless edits/diffs/revision checks, inferred and explicit resume mappings, fingerprints, workspace direct/Workday registries, read-only extraction tests, employer preservation and rotating budgets.

phases.name: native_pipeline_and_insights
phases.notes: Campaigns, workflow cards, preview, stage progress, problems/retries, application packets, second-opinion cache/budget, measured tokens/prices and submission cohorts.

phases.name: native_professional_studios
phases.notes: Multi-format multi-CV imports, originals/revisions/actions/PDFs, native Profile/Portfolio, scoped encrypted AI settings, source proposals, reusable evidence, writing drafts/validation/versioning/preview/download/publication.

phases.name: verification_and_deployment
phases.notes: 387 tests with Playwright, compilation, 7 AI regression checks and 13 formal cases passed. Docker rebuilt/recreated; production health/assets/routing/protected-input hashes and counts verified.
